preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (address 0xE44d394BB296739739617497aaD26c9117A43c77)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawAllToOwner() to drain all BUSD tokens accumulated in the contract from fees. This function swaps all accumulated IMPERIAL tokens for BUSD and sends them directly to the owner's specified receiver address. No other user interaction is required beyond the owner calling this privileged function.
